exclusions.source_text: Any other active malignancy at time of first dose of study treatment or diagnosis of another malignancy within 2 years prior to first dose of study treatment that requires active treatment, except for locally curable cancers that have been apparently cured, such as basal or squamous cell skin cancer or superficial bladder cancer.
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) status of ≤2 (Appendix A: Performance Status Criteria).
Bilirubin ≤ 1.3 x ULN (unless documented Gilbert's disease)
Serum glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase/aspartate transaminase (AST) ≤ 2.5 x ULN
Serum glutamic pyruvic transaminase/ alanine transaminase (ALT) ≤ 2.5 x ULN
Creatinine ≤ 1.5 x the institutional upper limit of normal (ULN)
Female partners must use hormonal or barrier contraception unless postmenopausal or abstinent.
cardiac disease that would preclude participation, as determined by the investigator
Untreated known or suspected brain metastases or spinal cord compression or clinically significant malignant epidural disease.
